title: PE's RVA needs to be mapped to file offsets by section
summary: RVA relative image base address. For sections with raw data, the file offset is PointerToRawData + (RVA − Section VirtualAddress).
detail: Make sure that the difference within the section falls within SizeOfRawData before the original file can be read. Trailers whose virtual size exceeds the original size can be zero-filled in the image.
boundary: Certain header areas are not treated as normal sections; this conversion does not apply to all data directories.
relevance: Map the relative addresses listed in the disassembly to the actual bytes in the attachment.
